notes: Cats: Italy in the Régionale bank (61 stems, 7 of them on the islands) and Italy Central & South in the Village bank (61 stems, 13 of them Sicilian or Sardinian); the four Marsala stems of the Village Fortified Wines category are counted in the review but the category is left out, since it is Port, Sherry and Madeira's. Chapters: the Régionale chapter islands, which teaches both islands and the Marsala grades; the Village chapter Italy Central & South (facts 10 and 11) and Fortified Wines, whose fact 9 is the only Village chapter line on Marsala's colours, grapes and grades. Regions: the sicily article (Etna and its contrade, Vittoria, Marsala, Pantelleria, Sicilia DOC) and the sardinia article (Gallura, the Cannonau sub-zones, Sulcis, Oristano). Country: italy for the national ladder. Grapes: the Court's varieties with a profile, Nero d’Avola as the Régionale profile prints it and Grenache for Cannonau; Carricante, Frappato, Grillo, Inzolia and Catarratto have none. Techniques and service tables: none, since the Court names no method and prints no service cell for the islands.
